voice: Thandi (ElevenLabs eleven_v4, BcpjRWrYhDBHmOnetmBl) single take, 17 Nov 2026

lines.text: A quarter percent. R204 more, every month.
That's what a 0.25% hike does to a R1.2 million home loan.
Prime goes from 10.75% to 11%. Your instalment jumps from R12,183 to R12,386.
Here's the trick for your own bond. Every quarter percent is about R17 a month, for every R100,000 you owe.
And a cut works the same way, in reverse.
The Reserve Bank's next decision: Thursday, 19 November.
Full repo rate guide on the channel.
So... what does a quarter percent cost you?
